This beautifully remodeled single-story home offers fresh exterior paint and great curb appeal including a charming brick front patio. Inside vaulted ceilings adorned with recessed lighting floods the oversized living room with light. Fresh interior paint and luxury vinyl plank flooring flows through this spacious home.
